title: Implement overdue visual state, dismissal and permitted repeatable alert

gates.name: Host overdue state and alert-policy probes

verify: Record honest pre-implementation RED for each FT-007 AC before changing production behavior; preserve any already-green FT-006 overdue projection prerequisite without claiming its evidence for this task.

Run deterministic host checks from a known isolated idle state for countdown completion, active-preset color projection, fullscreen overdue state data, blinking-plus versus stable numeric counter, full elapsed arithmetic and visual persistence until dismissal; reset state after the probe.
Run single-tap and double-tap overdue dismissal checks and prove both stop the alert request, clear the overdue projection and return to Main Display; audio denial must not block either path.

Run isolated synthetic audio-policy checks for all three accepted built-in signals, default Classic selection, the 5–10 second ramp, repeat-until-dismissal behavior and the 30-minute audio cap; distinguish silent mode, DND and unavailable-route suppression from the visual result.

Run the accepted temporary-resume path using persisted FT-006 timer data and prove that an already-overdue state re-establishes the same visual projection, any-tap dismissal and permitted alert policy; do not add or test reboot recovery.

Inspect Timer & Alert ownership and the registered Main Display -> Timer & Alert, Timer & Alert -> Settings & Location, Timer & Alert -> Android Runtime Adapter and Main Display -> Android Runtime Adapter edges; no private storage, direct platform bypass or composition-root business orchestration is permitted.

Use isolated/resettable local state, synthetic platform-policy inputs and cleanup that cannot affect another run. Host/build/unit/static/policy checks are mandatory. Apply target-device evidence only where host checks cannot establish fullscreen/readability, actual ramp or custom-ROM silent/DND/audio-route behavior; it is deferred/non-blocking, so record DEFERRED plus residual risk when unavailable and never claim runtime PASS without a target. Record no runtime evidence during planning.

Scheduler closure: attempt-1 functional/semantic failure was corrected within FT-007 by retry attempt 2; fresh `/verify` returned VERDICT: PASS and fresh `/red-verify` returned SEMANTIC_VERDICT: semantic-pass. Same-runtime resume, repeat/cap/suppression, all FT-007 AC-001..AC-005, host/build/static gates pass. Target evidence remains DEFERRED/non-blocking with no runtime PASS claim. Evidence: .protocols/TASK-009-T3-FT-007-W8/verification.md, .protocols/TASK-009-T3-FT-007-W8/red-verification.md, .tasks/TASK-009-T3-FT-007-W8/verifier-owned-probe.md.
evidence_required: [FT-007-AC-001; REQ-015] Expected RED: the FT-006 lifecycle surface has no task-owned fullscreen overdue presentation with the active preset color and accepted blink split. GREEN: the active preset expands into the accepted fullscreen neon area, `+` blinks and the numeric counter does not; compare each condition and store the mandatory deterministic presentation result, with scoped target-display evidence deferred/non-blocking where host proof is insufficient.

[FT-007-AC-002; REQ-015] Expected RED: the current overdue projection does not prove full elapsed time from the persisted start or visual persistence until dismissal. GREEN: the counter includes the configured duration, remains numerically stable and the visual state remains until a tap; compare the projected elapsed value and dismissal boundary in the isolated state/projection artifact.

[FT-007-AC-003; REQ-015] Expected RED: no accepted any-tap overdue dismissal path is available. GREEN: both single and double tap clear the overdue state, stop the alert request and return to Main Display; compare both gesture outcomes in the deterministic transition artifact.

[FT-007-AC-004; REQ-016] Expected RED: no task-owned repeatable built-in alert policy proves the accepted signal set, default, ramp or cap. GREEN: `Классический`, `Колокольчик` and `Электронный` use the selected/default value, ramp for 5–10 seconds, repeat until dismissal and stop at 30 minutes; compare signal, timing and stop conditions in the mandatory isolated audio-policy artifact, with target-ROM evidence deferred/non-blocking where host proof is insufficient.

[FT-007-AC-005; REQ-016] Expected RED: audio suppression is not yet shown to preserve overdue presentation and dismissal. GREEN: silent mode, DND and unavailable route suppress only audio while the visual state remains and any tap still dismisses it; compare each policy input against the visual/audio result in the platform-policy integration artifact.

T3 isolation and safe rerun: each proof starts from known disposable idle state with synthetic timestamps and platform-policy inputs, records the observable result and decisive pass/fail comparison, and cleans up without live credentials, external permissions or durable cross-run state.
purpose: Turn the FT-006 overdue lifecycle projection into the accepted FT-007 completion outcome while preserving Timer & Alert ownership, Android audio policy and the visual state when audio is suppressed.
success_outcome: A clean Android build and deterministic redacted evidence prove that timer completion renders the active preset as a fullscreen neon overdue state with a blinking plus and stable full elapsed counter, any single or double tap dismisses it and stops the alert, and the accepted repeatable built-in alert obeys its ramp, 30-minute cap and Android silent/DND/route policy without suppressing the visual state.
anti_goals: Do not reimplement FT-005 preset validation, defaults, labels, colors or Settings configuration.

Do not reimplement FT-006 countdown start, remaining-time arithmetic, protected countdown cancellation or temporary lifecycle recovery; consume its accepted overdue state and prove only the overdue integration delta.
Do not implement FT-009 user-facing sound/volume Settings, auto-save or validation; use the accepted validated projection/default seam.
Do not add reboot recovery, backend/cloud/accounts, Google Services, event/message infrastructure, new runtime permissions, direct private-storage access, live credentials or unaccepted UI scope.
Do not claim target-device or runtime evidence during planning.

forbidden_scope: FT-005 preset configuration and FT-006 countdown/cancellation implementation beyond the accepted overdue projection seam
FT-008 location/API-key behavior and FT-009 user-facing sound/volume/glass Settings behavior
direct reads or writes of private Settings & Location or Main Display storage
business orchestration in MainActivity, generic utilities or the composition root
reboot recovery, backend, cloud sync, accounts, Google Services, event/message infrastructure and new permissions
live API keys or secret-bearing source, logs, screenshots, fixtures or evidence
stop_conditions: Stop and ask the operator before adding a dependency or changing the accepted UI toolkit, package/public contract, architecture, persistence/security posture or product behavior.
Stop and route to /spec-design if execution requires a new module, graph edge, ownership rule, public contract, audio permission or composition-root business behavior.
Stop and route to /feature-to-tasks FT-007 if execution exposes a required identity, tier, dependency, acceptance or material-scope change; do not hide it behind repair.
Stop and route to /feature-doctor FT-007 or /write-prd if the accepted overdue presentation, dismissal, alert cap or silent/DND semantics must change.
Stop and route to /feature-to-tasks FT-009 if completion-time behavior requires a new user-facing sound/volume Settings outcome rather than consuming the accepted validated projection.

constraints: Timer & Alert is the sole owner of active-timer state, overdue transitions, elapsed interpretation and alert requests; consumers use its public projection and commands.
Main Display owns fullscreen composition and gesture dispatch through the accepted Main Display -> Timer & Alert contract; it does not calculate elapsed time or access timer storage.
Timer & Alert reads the validated sound/volume/default projection from Settings & Location and never writes Settings directly; user-facing personalization remains FT-009 scope.
Android Runtime Adapter owns lifecycle/display/audio signals and silent/DND/route policy; the visual overdue state remains product-owned and independent of audio permission.
The 30-minute cap applies to audio only; the visual overdue state remains until accepted manual dismissal. Temporary resume reuses the persisted lifecycle state and does not add reboot recovery.
invariants: .memory-bank/invariants.md#must: only one active timer, overdue state is always visual, and audio is permission/cap governed.
.memory-bank/invariants.md#never: automatic timer recovery after reboot, event infrastructure, backend/cloud/Google Services or unaccepted V1 scope.
.memory-bank/contracts/boundary-map.md#accepted-ownership-summary: Timer & Alert owns the product overdue state; Android owns only audio policy.
.memory-bank/states/lifecycle-map.md#timer-state-contract: overdue retains timer identity, full elapsed time and any-tap dismissal; the numeric counter does not blink.
.memory-bank/domains/local-data.md#durable-data-rules: active timer recovery uses persisted start/duration data and validated Settings values remain owner-local.
verification_targets: FT-007-AC-001 / REQ-015: active preset color expands into fullscreen overdue presentation; plus blinks and numeric counter does not.
FT-007-AC-002 / REQ-015: elapsed counter is full time from persisted start including configured duration, and visual overdue state persists until tap.
FT-007-AC-003 / REQ-015: single or double tap anywhere dismisses overdue, stops the alert and returns to Main Display.
FT-007-AC-004 / REQ-016: selected/default built-in signal, 5–10 second ramp, repeat-until-dismissal and 30-minute audio cap are all enforced.
FT-007-AC-005 / REQ-016: silent mode, DND or unavailable audio route suppresses only audio; overdue visual state and dismissal remain available.

.memory-bank/contracts/boundary-map.md#dependency-graph: only registered Main Display -> Timer & Alert, Main Display -> Android Runtime Adapter, Timer & Alert -> Settings & Location and Timer & Alert -> Android Runtime Adapter edges are used; no private-store or composition-root business bypass exists.

.memory-bank/states/lifecycle-map.md#timer-state-contract: an already-overdue persisted timer re-establishes the same visual/audio-policy path after temporary interruption; reboot recovery is excluded.
.memory-bank/testing/runtime-verification.md#deterministic-host-side-checks: state, elapsed, gesture and synthetic policy checks are reproducible.

.memory-bank/testing/runtime-verification.md#target-device-evidence: target evidence is limited to host-insufficient fullscreen/readability, ramp and custom-ROM audio-policy behavior, is deferred/non-blocking while unavailable, and requires DEFERRED plus residual risk rather than a runtime PASS claim; planning claims no runtime evidence.
